newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares strong ahead of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares strong ahead of settlement.

text.p: Delhi shares surged higher in the afternoon trade on Thursday as speculators and institutional investors covered short-positions ahead of the last day of the fortnightly settlement, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's Sensitive index was 11.31 points higher at 899.34 at 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT). Friday is the last day of current settlement period.
"Ahead of tommorrow's settlement close, operators were forced to cover their positions, pushing share prices higher," said Avinash Arora of brokers V.K. Jain and Company.
Traders said shares of tobacco-maker ITC were in spotlight following reports that the company's net profit for the first quarter of 1997/98 (April-March) has risen sharply.
The Business Standard newspaper said ITC had reported a 34 percent jump in net profit for the first quarter ending June 30, 1997.
ITC rose 31.70 rupees, or 6.7 percent, to 504.70 on strong buying by foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
State Bank of India gained 6.15 rupees to 322.50.
Larsen and Toubro edged up 1.00 rupees to 270.10.
